Name: Rehabilitation
Description: Player can capture and emprison enemies to place them in "training facilities" to override behavior, change stats and maybe become allies. Each enemy can have their own strengths and weaknesses in the process.

Name: Transmutation
Description: Use village-farmed components to empower equipment

Name: "Spread the word"
Description: Allies can be sent to adventures, where they'll get rare resources and occasionally more allies (via rehabilitation or not)
